info.title: YGG API
info.description: League of Legends match analysis API

post.description: Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and rotates the cookie.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or reused refresh token

post.description:
Deletes your account and everything of yours: linked LoL accounts, snapshots, analyses and sessions. Asks for the password, with
an attempt limit, and closes the session. Administrators cannot (they would leave the site with none).

Links one of the user's accounts, validating it against the Riot API. 404 if it doesn't exist in Riot, 409 if they already have it
linked or already have MAX_ACCOUNTS. That it is theirs is proven afterwards by its profile icon (`/verify`).

put.description: Updates a player's editable fields (role, nickname, notes).

delete.description: Deletes a player and their snapshots.

post.description:
Checks with Riot that the account has the profile icon on that was requested when linking it: only whoever
has the account can change it. A LoL account is verified by a single YGG user.

409.description: The profile icon is not the one asked, or another user verified it

get.description: Performance by role over all the player's stored matches.

post.description: Refreshes the player's rank and icon by querying the Riot API.

get.description: One point per day since tracking was turned on, from oldest to newest.

The player's history by pages, from the newest match to the oldest.

The first page comes from the database if it was synced less than an
hour ago; the others follow Riot's pagination, reusing what is already stored. If
Riot fails, what is stored is served for that page.

get.description: Matches of a snapshot, from newest to oldest (DB only).

WPA timeline of a match in the snapshot: each event the player took part in,
with the win-probability points attributed to them, the WP curve and the grade.

404.description: Not a match of that snapshot

get.description: Per-champion performance over the player's stored matches (history and analysis).

parameters.name: season

schema.description: Only games from the current season
schema.title: Season

parameters.description: Only games from the current season

get.description:
The 10 participants of a match: build, stats and relative score.

The first time it is requested from Riot and stored; afterwards it comes from the database.

404.description: Not a match of the user's players (or not stored, in the demo)

get.description:
Rank of the 10 players and the lobby's average elo.

It is requested when the match is expanded. It is computed the first time with the rank of that
moment (Riot doesn't store the one they had when playing) and afterwards it is served stored.

404.description: Not a match of the user's players

get.description: A player's snapshots, from newest to oldest.

post.description:
Enqueues the analysis of a period and returns its job. Since 16.20 snapshots require replay access, and their matches
must be from a single build (`_one_build`).

Idempotent: if there is already an analysis running for the same player and rank, that
job is returned instead of launching another. Progress is followed over SSE at
GET /snapshots/jobs/{job_id}/stream.

get.description:
Real-time progress via Server-Sent Events.

SSE and not WebSockets: the flow is one-directional, works over plain HTTP
and the browser reconnects by itself. On connecting (or reconnecting) the
current state is sent first.

200.description: `progress`, `done` and `error` events with a SnapshotJobStatus as JSON

post.description: Re-enqueues a failed analysis (for example, an interrupted one).

409.description: The job has not failed, or an equivalent analysis is running

get.description: Since when replay analysis exists (the web calendar doesn't allow requesting earlier).

delete.description: Deletes a snapshot; the matches are kept for other snapshots.

get.description: The snapshot's dashboard (cached). `compare_*` overlays another account's radar live.

The snapshot's replay analysis: its status and, when it finishes, its numbers and the review. While it is
running, each query advances it with the replays you have already uploaded (`premium.refresh`).

post.description:
Launches (or relaunches) the replay analysis of an already made snapshot: requests its matches (again the ones that failed),
which wait for you to upload their replays. If it is already running, it is returned as it is.
Finishes the analysis with the replays already uploaded: the missing ones come out as not uploaded.

get.description: Your uploaded and analysed matches, from newest to oldest, and the quota you have left.
The analysis of one of your matches (the web opens it in its own tab).

post.description:
The .rofl you downloaded with your client. Before spending quota it is checked that it is that match (the file's ten Riot IDs are
Riot's) and that your account played it; then it stays in `processing` until `done` or `error` comes out.
A match already analysed or in progress is returned as it is.

400.description: Not a replay, or not this game

403.description: Your linked account didn't play this game

429.description: Free limit reached for the last 24 hours

get.description:
Grandmaster and Challenger LP cutoffs for a platform (cached for 4 hours).

Both come from the combined Challenger + Grandmaster + Master ladder sorted by LP:

- Grandmaster cutoff: LP of the player at overall rank 1000 (last GM slot).
- Challenger cutoff: LP of the player at overall rank 300 (last Challenger slot).

ChampionStatsResponse.title: ChampionStatsResponse
ChampionStatsResponse.description:
Performance with one champion in the snapshot.

kills, deaths, assists, the @14 differences and the deaths by phase are per-match
means; kda and the per-minute rates come from the total of their matches.

DeleteAccount.title: DeleteAccount
DeleteAccount.description: Deleting your account asks for the password: a stolen session isn't enough to take your data.

EloPoint.title: EloPoint
EloPoint.description: The rank of one day (the last one queried that day).

LobbyRank.title: LobbyRank
LobbyRank.description:
Rank of each player and the lobby's average elo, taken the first time the match was opened.

Riot doesn't store the rank they had when playing. With no ranked players, tier, division and lp are null.

kda_status.title: Kda Status
kda_status.description: KDA against the role's Challenger matches.

MatchParticipantDetails.title: MatchParticipantDetails
MatchParticipantDetails.description:
A participant in the match.

`score` is their 0-100 grade against the role's Challenger matches: 70 is playing better than two out of three
(ygg_core/metrics/match_score.py).

kda_status.title: Kda Status
kda_status.description: KDA against the role's Challenger matches.

cs_status.title: Cs Status
cs_status.description: CS/min against the role's Challenger range.

dmg_status.title: Dmg Status
dmg_status.description: Damage/min against the role's Challenger range.

quest_reward_item.title: Quest Reward Item
quest_reward_item.description: Role Quest reward if it was completed (the ADC's boots, the top's Teleport...), or 0.

kda_status.title: Kda Status
kda_status.description: KDA against the Challenger matches of their most played role.

cs_status.title: Cs Status
cs_status.description: CS/min against the Challenger range of their most played role.

dmg_status.title: Dmg Status
dmg_status.description: Damage/min against the Challenger range of their most played role.

PlayerChampionStats.title: PlayerChampionStats
PlayerChampionStats.description:
A player's performance with one champion (SQL query player_champion_stats).

kills, deaths, assists and vision_score are per-match means; kda and the per-minute
ratios are computed over the total of their matches with that champion.

PlayerCreate.title: PlayerCreate
PlayerCreate.description: What the API receives when creating a player. No puuid or id — the system generates them.

PlayerRank.title: PlayerRank
PlayerRank.description: A player's SoloQ rank; tier, division and lp as null if they have none.

PlayerResponse.title: PlayerResponse
PlayerResponse.description: What the API returns. Includes id, puuid, rank data and icon.

PremiumAnalysisResponse.title: PremiumAnalysisResponse
PremiumAnalysisResponse.description:
A snapshot's replay analysis. `result` is the numbers and the chart series; `review`,
what Claude writes. Both empty until it finishes.

PremiumCoverage.title: PremiumCoverage
PremiumCoverage.description: Since when a replay analysis can be requested: the first patch with replays and exe.

kda_status.title: Kda Status
kda_status.description: KDA against the role's Challenger matches.

RoleSummary.title: RoleSummary
RoleSummary.description: A player's aggregated performance in one role (SQL query player_role_summary).

SeasonSync.title: SeasonSync
SeasonSync.description: Result of fetching a page of the season.

SnapshotCreate.title: SnapshotCreate
SnapshotCreate.description: What the API receives when launching an analysis.

SnapshotDashboardResponse.title: SnapshotDashboardResponse
SnapshotDashboardResponse.description:
Dashboard of a snapshot.

It does not include the list of matches (P9): they are requested paginated at
GET /matches/snapshot/{snapshot_id}. That way the response fits in the cache and doesn't
grow with the number of matches.

SnapshotJobResponse.title: SnapshotJobResponse
SnapshotJobResponse.description: Response when launching an analysis. If an identical one was already running, it is that same job.

SnapshotJobStatus.title: SnapshotJobStatus
SnapshotJobStatus.description: Status of an analysis. Same format in GET /jobs/{id} and in the SSE events.

SnapshotNotesUpdate.title: SnapshotNotesUpdate
SnapshotNotesUpdate.description: For editing the notes inline from the UI.

SnapshotResponse.title: SnapshotResponse
SnapshotResponse.description: What the API returns when listing snapshots.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Short-lived access token. The refresh token travels separately, in an httpOnly cookie.

UserLogin.title: UserLogin
UserLogin.description: Credentials to sign in (no policy: old accounts must be able to get in).

UserRegister.title: UserRegister
UserRegister.description: Data needed to register a new user.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description: Public data of the authenticated user.

WaitingGame.title: WaitingGame
WaitingGame.description: A match in the snapshot whose replay is still to be uploaded.

WpaDriverResponse.title: WpaDriverResponse
WpaDriverResponse.description: A part of the state that changed with the event and the points of its value that it explains.

WpaEventResponse.title: WpaEventResponse
WpaEventResponse.description:
An event the player took part in, with the win-probability points attributed to them.

The why (team_wpa, share, shared_with, drivers) is missing from matches analysed before version 5.

WpaTimelineResponse.title: WpaTimelineResponse
WpaTimelineResponse.description: WPA timeline of a match in a snapshot. Empty if it was analysed before WPA existed.
